text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Guh... How careless of me.
To misjudge my own limits like this.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you keep pushing yourself recklessly,
you will only waste your time as a competitor.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This is not what I desire either.
I understand that... I understand, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Simply resting in bed will cause the body to wither.
That is also the truth. ...In that case—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We'll continue training...
and offset any arising risks through careful management.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to unleash that power.
...Could one not say as much?
choice_data_list: Strict bed rest until you're fully healed.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...... But still—
choice_data_list: You have a long racing career ahead of you. Right?
Your racing career will be long. Wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to the long road I'll run with you...
this is merely a brief pause."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. Then, could we think through a plan for my comeback together?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Seeing me in such a lackluster state... please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though it took some time until a full recovery, Ikuno Dictus was somehow able to return to training.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...*pant*... *gasp*...
The pain is ruining... my concentration... Damn it...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's all due to my own inadequacy...
I am so very sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It ended up taking quite a bit of time
for Ikuno Dictus to return to training...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I don't feel the effects of the injury at all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems she was able to carefully assess the situation
and choose a routine that wouldn't irritate the injury.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With this... the risk of worsening it is minimized,
while still allowing a reasonable amount of exercise...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"With this...
I can keep moving forward...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "The insights gained here could prove useful to all Umamusume dealing with injuries."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's continue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Ikuno Dictus made a miraculously swift recovery!
